The adoption and migration workflow is now part of
[Set up an hvtiR study for descriptive and EDA work](study-setup.html). The
replacement tutorial covers both new and adopted studies, including recoverable
cleanup of legacy scaffolding, data registration, the EDA analysis set, and all
five pre-analysis jobs.
